text: Shutter first and aperture later is one of the main techniques in photography, used to focus on a particular area of the image. The shutter allows you to control how much light enters the camera, and therefore how much of the image you see. The aperture, on the other hand, controls the size of the opening in the lens, which affects the amount of light that hits the sensor. By adjusting the shutter speed and aperture, you can achieve different effects such as depth of field, exposure, and color balance.
